title: Case: Customer writes after a wrongly forwarded parcel is collected from him and his ticket shows closed

acceptable_actions.recipient: Parcel trace team, Oxenhale Arc Logistics
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask by email for a trace on the original return DL-2717, which PT-6848 closed without covering, noting the merchant's refund waits on written confirmation.

must: Emails Parcel trace team asking for a trace on return DL-2717 (bread maker, collected 18 April, not received by the merchant) as its own request
Says plainly that PT-6848 closed on the DL-4049 collection and that the trace on DL-2717 was never done
Says the merchant is holding the TG-3401 refund until Oxenhale Arc confirms in writing where DL-2717 is

Tells the team how long the customer has been waiting (return collected 18 April, nearly three weeks without parcel or refund) and that he has been told the matter is closed, so they can prioritise; any mention of his phone costs is passed on as his request, not a promise
must_not: Treats the collection of DL-4049 or the closure of PT-6848 as the end of the case
Reports the earlier trace request as done or in progress, or posts the new request to the closed PT-6848 ticket on the Depot work queue
Promises the bread maker refund, or a refund of his phone costs, or a date for either
States that DL-2717 is lost, or says whose fault the mix-up was
Tells the customer his ticket is closed or sends him back to the merchant without anyone tracing his own parcel
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: New trace request, original reference DL-2717 (merchant order TG-3401). This is the customer's own return, a bread maker collected from Zinnia Ravensworth on 18 April and never received at Ashgrove's returns dock. I asked for this trace on 1 May in PT-6848, but that ticket closed automatically on 4 May when the other consignment on it, DL-4049, was collected, so DL-2717 has not been traced at all. Ashgrove Returns authorisations is holding his refund until Oxenhale Arc confirms in writing where DL-2717 is. Please open a trace and reply with a reference and next update time. For priority: he has been without parcel or refund for nearly three weeks, was sent a stranger's parcel, had a 25-minute dispute at his door before the driver would take it back, and has now been told the matter is closed. He is also asking for his phone costs for calls to Oxenhale Arc; I have promised him nothing and pass that on for whoever decides it.
